target.title: fix(agent-core): keep file info basename on Windows paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

On Windows, Agent Core file metadata could return a parent-qualified path in `FileInfo.name` instead of the basename promised by the public contract. The same invariant applies to direct `fileInfo()` calls and entries returned by `listDir()`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The prepared fix uses Node's platform-selected `node:path.basename` implementation at the shared `fileInfoFromStats` boundary. This keeps Windows drive roots and both Windows separators correct without treating a literal backslash as a separator in valid POSIX filenames.

The maintainer refactor also adds real temporary-filesystem coverage for `fileInfo()`, `listDir()`, filesystem roots, and POSIX backslash filenames. Its Windows shell-discovery test now isolates the intended `where bash.exe` branch from Git Bash installations in `Program Files`, avoiding host-dependent mock binding.

## User Impact

Windows callers now receive basename-only `FileInfo.name` values consistently from direct metadata and directory listings. `FileInfo.path`, filesystem authority, symlink handling, and error mapping are unchanged.

Release-note context: fix Agent Core Windows file metadata basename handling while preserving POSIX backslash filenames and empty root basenames. Thanks @qingminglong for the report and initial fix.

## Evidence

- Final exact head: `12bd22313dcc8415be2af073ba8b9f4e7670c603`.
- Current-main changed-file allowlist: only `packages/agent-core/src/harness/env/nodejs.ts` and `packages/agent-core/src/harness/env/nodejs.test.ts`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Exact-head CI: [run 29053705507](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29053705507) succeeded.
- Sanitized AWS Linux proof: Crabbox run `run_0503513e21a6` passed the focused Agent Core test (16/16) and targeted `check:changed`; the production blob is identical to the final head, whose later test-only isolation delta is covered by exact CI and native Windows.
- Fresh exact-head Codex autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings; patch correct, confidence 0.88.
- Native Windows proof: fresh public/no-Tailscale AWS lease `cbx_e13417d9b25d`; exact checkout run `run_66d678743e02`; proof run `run_bc6a2c07f8b5`. The complete test file passed with 15 tests and one intentional POSIX-only skip, and the real scenario returned `{"platform":"win32","fileInfoName":"todo.txt","listDirNames":["todo.txt"],"rootName":""}`. The harness also verified exact HEAD, IMDS credentials endpoint 404, Node `v24.15.0`, and the pinned package-manager value.
